entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> Give to the Lord, you sons of the gods, give to the Lord glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Give to the Lord the full glory of his name; give him worship in holy robes.

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of the Lord is on the waters: the God of glory is thundering, the Lord is on the great waters.

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of the Lord is full of power; the voice of the Lord has a noble sound.

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: By the voice of the Lord are the cedar-trees broken, even the cedars of Lebanon are broken by the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: He makes them go jumping about like a young ox; Lebanon and Sirion like a young mountain ox.

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: At the voice of the Lord flames of fire are seen.

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: At the voice of the Lord there is a shaking in the waste land, even a shaking in the waste land of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: At the voice of the Lord the roes give birth, the leaves are taken from the trees: in his Temple everything says, Glory.

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: The Lord had his seat as king when the waters came on the earth; the Lord is seated as king for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will give his people the blessing of peace.
